privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This policy explains the data the academy needs to provide its services and how it protects and limits its use.
privacy.draftDescription: This text is not final for launch until approved by management and legal counsel for the students’ jurisdictions.

collection.title: Data we collect
collection.body: Student, guardian, contact, country, time zone, track, and availability details, followed by the lesson, attendance, evaluation, progress, and billing records required to provide the service.

purpose.title: How data is used
purpose.body: We use data to review applications, assign teachers, schedule lessons, track learning, issue reports and invoices, secure accounts, and meet legal obligations.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell data. We share the minimum necessary with infrastructure and email providers under appropriate controls. Teachers and families do not receive each other’s private contact details.

children.title: Children’s data
children.body: Applications for students under 18 require a guardian name and consent. Child data is limited to authorized roles, with no public rankings or external behavioral analytics.

retention.title: Retention & deletion
retention.body: Records are retained for educational, financial, and legal needs, then deleted or de-identified under a retention schedule approved for the applicable jurisdiction.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, restriction, or deletion where law permits. Financial and audit records may be retained when legally required.

security.title: Security
security.body: Controls include role-based access, administrator MFA, transport encryption, audit trails, and encrypted backups. No digital system can eliminate every risk.

contact.title: Contact & requests
contact.body: Use the official contact page for privacy questions and rights requests. The final version will identify the responsible entity, address, and statutory response period.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.summary: These terms govern use of the academy portals, lessons, plans, reports, and payments.
terms.draftDescription: Final provisions, governing law, and refund policy require management and legal approval.

service.title: The service
service.body: The academy provides one-to-one remote learning under the selected track, package, and schedule. Outcomes depend on level and participation and are not guaranteed.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Users must provide accurate information, protect passwords and authentication codes, and promptly report suspected unauthorized access.

lessons.title: Lessons & attendance
lessons.body: Lesson duration, cancellation notice, makeup, and absence rules follow the package policy snapshot accepted at subscription, with administrative exceptions audited.

payments.title: Fees & payments
payments.body: Prices appear in the selected country’s currency. Subscription and invoice values are snapshotted when issued. Refunds follow the package policy and applicable law.

conduct.title: Acceptable conduct
conduct.body: Users must not misuse the service, share lesson links or accounts, bypass access controls, or harm teachers, students, or the platform.

content.title: Content & materials
content.body: Educational materials and academy branding remain with their owners. Quran dataset records are internal progress references, and verse text is not displayed by the product.

termination.title: Suspension & termination
termination.body: Accounts may be suspended to protect users, for material breach, or non-payment, subject to required notice and financial or statutory rights.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: Limitations apply only to the extent permitted by law and never exclude liability that cannot legally be excluded. Final wording depends on the service jurisdictions.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: Each version and date is recorded. Fresh consent is requested before continued use when a material change requires it.

consequences.confirmPayment: The transaction becomes confirmed and financial ledgers and receipts may be updated. Corrections require a separate reversal.
consequences.rejectPayment: The pending transaction will be rejected and will not count as a confirmed payment.
consequences.recordPayment: A new payment or refund record will be created for later confirmation.
consequences.approvePayout: The payout will move to approved and its payable amount will be fixed for the next step.
consequences.payPayout: The payout will be recorded as paid using the supplied reference. Do not continue until the transfer is complete.
consequences.addExpense: The expense will be added to financial reports in its stated currency.
consequences.publishReport: The report will become visible to the student and linked guardians.
consequences.withdrawReport: The report will stop being visible to the student and linked guardians.
consequences.publishAnnouncement: The announcement will become visible to its configured audience.
consequences.archiveAnnouncement: The announcement will leave the active published list while its audit history remains.
consequences.publishTemplate: This version becomes immutable and available for approved use.
consequences.archiveTemplate: The template will no longer be active; previously published versions remain in history.
consequences.disableAccount: The user will lose access until an administrator reactivates the account.
consequences.archiveRecord: The record leaves active workflows but remains retained according to current rules.
consequences.publishCertificateTemplate: This template version becomes immutable and can be used for certificate issuance.
consequences.revokeCertificate: The certificate will fail public verification and the revocation reason will be retained.
consequences.lockExamResult: The result becomes final and cannot be edited through the normal grading flow.
consequences.lockEvaluation: The evaluation becomes final and visible according to current permissions; unlocking remains restricted.
